correctness.rationale: Every disconnected five-set of K3 Cartesian K4 is enumerated (264 of 792), all 2489 cut-complex faces rebuilt, 1218 matching pairs certified acyclic by a full 2488-vertex Hasse DAG test, and signed integral Morse boundaries recomputed. Critical counts (1;9,6,36 in dims 0;4,5,6) and a single primitive unit boundary yield free reduced H4=Z^8, H5=Z^5, H6=Z^36 and zero otherwise. Direct mod-two original simplicial ranks independently corroborate each Betti number. The finite calculation is exhaustive and complete for the claimed finite graph.

value.rationale: This is the natural next cut threshold for the smallest non-square three-row rook graph, beyond indexed three- and four-cut results. Its full additive integral homology occupies three consecutive degrees, a substantive topological obstruction to shellability and Cohen-Macaulayness, and provides a precise natural boundary datum for a wider rook cut filtration. It is not merely an Euler characteristic, routine substitution, or arbitrary slice of a larger known theorem.
